commitments.detail: All project handoffs will be conducted via email.
Project handoffs will include a detailed document outlining all necessary context and expected responses.
Dana and Eli must respond within 48 hours of receiving a project handoff.
This operating plan will be in effect for the next 12 weeks.
Unscheduled one-on-one meetings are not allowed under this plan.
Any issues arising from the handoff process can be addressed through an informal meeting between the two parties.
If either party needs to request a repair meeting, they must provide notice at least 24 hours in advance.
